intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Wasilla for 2026, and here is what he found: 11 family events, 3 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Every Christmas Story Ever Told (And Then Some)) through December 22 (the North Star Express puppet show at the Wasilla Public Library), with Christmas in the Park at Iditapark (December 5), Photos With Santa (December 12) and Pictures with Santa (December 13) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
